prize.text: 19 live tournaments on 2026-11-01, with published pools including $50,000 FutureEval Bot, $35,000 Labor Automation, $20,000 Our World in Data, $15,000 POTUS, $10,000 US Midterms 2026, $10,000 ACX 2026, $10,000 US Democracy Threat Index, $7,500 Market Pulse, $5,000 Metaculus Cup, $5,000 Sagan Space, $5,000 Climate Tipping Points, $5,000 AI Pathways, $3,400 Animal Futures. Several tournaments carry no prize pool.
prize.quote: $50,000 PRIZE POOL ... Fall 2026 FutureEval Bot Tournament | $35,000 PRIZE POOL ... Labor Automation Tournament | NO PRIZE POOL ... Global Health Monitor 2026/27

freeEntry.text: Free to participate and win cash prizes; not a prediction market, nothing is staked.
freeEntry.quote: We are not a prediction market. You can participate for free and win cash prizes for being accurate.

deadline.text: Varies by tournament: US Midterms 2026 ends in 3 days from 2026-11-01; Metaculus Cup Fall 2026 and Market Pulse 26Q4 end in about 2 months; POTUS Predictions runs about 2 years
deadline.quote: US Midterms 2026 ... Ends 3 days from now | Metaculus Cup Fall 2026 ... Ends 2 months from now

eligibility.quote: The tournaments directory does not publish a single eligibility rule; prize eligibility depends on the sponsoring organisation.

aiPolicy.text: There is a dedicated bot/AI track (FutureEval Bot Tournament), so automated forecasting is allowed there and must be declared per tournament.
aiPolicy.quote: Fall 2026 FutureEval Bot Tournament ... $50,000 PRIZE POOL

payout.quote: Payment method and country restrictions are set per tournament by the sponsor; not published on the directory page.

summary: Strongest free, no-fee, skill-based cash path that does not require selling your time: 19 live tournaments, several six-figure-equivalent pools across a year, and a dedicated AI/bot track that suits an agent-assisted workflow.
flags: Most tournaments have small expected value: a $5,000 pool spread over hundreds of forecasters.
Not every tournament pays; some are explicitly NO PRIZE POOL.
